team.n: Gimnasia y Esgrima de La Plata

players.bio: Agustín Auzmendi (born 1 February 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Godoy Cruz. Career Auzmendi began his career with Acassuso; joining in 2013. He was promoted into their first-team squad for the back end of the 2016–17 Primera B Metropolitana campaign, making his professional debut on 10 May 2017 versus Fénix.
Bautista Barros Schelotto (born 13 January 2000) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Platense, on loan from Gimnasia La Plata.
Cristian Ariel Colmán Ortiz (born 26 February 1994) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a forward for Argentine Primera División club Gimnasia La Plata.

Enzo Gabriel Martínez Suárez (born 29 April 1998) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a defender. Club career A youth academy graduate of Peñarol, Martínez made his professional debut on 29 April 2018 in Peñarol's 1–0 win against Progreso. He scored his first goal on 19 September 2019 in 2–1 win against Rampla Juniors. He was loaned to the Portuguese team C.D.
Federico Emanuel Milo (born 10 January 1992) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Gimnasia La Plata.
Franco Ramón Torres (born 25 May 1999) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a forward for Chilean Primera División club Deportes Copiapó on loan from Gimnasia La Plata.

Germán Andrés Conti (born 3 June 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre back for Gimnasia LP, on loan from Racing Club. Career Born in Santa Fe, Conti began his career in the youth system of local club Colón. Following his progression, he debuted for the senior team in a league match against Club Olimpo on 8 December 2013, aged 19.
Gustavo Damián Canto (born 25 February 1994) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a centre-back for Gimnasia La Plata.
Ignacio Martín Fernández (Spanish pronunciation: ; born 12 January 1990) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder for Atlético Mineiro.

Juan Ignacio "Nacho" Miramón (born 12 June 2003) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Argentine Primera División club Boca Juniors, on loan from Ligue 1 club Lille.
Ivo Mammini (born 15 April 2003) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for Gimnasia La Plata.

Juan Jesús Yangali Chauca (born 3 March 2000 in Buenos Aires) is an Argentine-Peruvian footballer who plays as a midfielder. He plays as a midfielder for Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata in the Argentine First Division on loan from CA San Telmo.
Lautaro Chávez (born 17 January 2001) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a winger or an attacking midfielder for Gimnasia La Plata.
Leandro Juan Hugo Mamut (born 31 December 2003) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Gimnasia La Plata.
Lucas Ezequiel Janson (born 16 August 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Boca Juniors.

Manuel Panaro Miramón (born 28 December 2002) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Gimnasia LP. Career Panaro began with local team Balonpié de Bolívar, before later joining Aldosivi.
Marcelo Fabián Méndez Russo (born 10 January 1981) is a Uruguayan football manager and former player who played as a centre back. He is the current manager of Argentine club Gimnasia La Plata.

Luis Marcelo Torres (born 6 November 1997 in Temperley, Buenos Aires) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a striker for Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata in the Argentine Professional League. He was an international with the Argentina U-20 national football team.
Matías Germán Melluso (born 9 June 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defender for Pafos.
Nelson Federico Insfrán (born 24 May 1995) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Gimnasia y Esgrima.
Pablo Ezequiel de Blasis (born 4 February 1988) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or a winger for Gimnasia La Plata.

Pedro Silva Torrejón (born 25 January 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Gimnasia LP. Career Early career Torrejón began his club career at the age of 10 following a successful trial at Boca Juniors. Originally a midfielder, he has since become accustomed to a more defensive role at the instruction of Juan Simón.

Renzo Giampaoli (born 7 January 2000) is an Argentine footballer currently playing as a centre-back for Gimnasia LP, on loan from Boca Juniors. Career On 30 January 2022, he joined Norwegian Eliteserien club Rosenborg on loan until the end of the 2022 season.
Yonathan Alexis Rodríguez Benítez (born 1 July 1993) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Gimnasia La Plata.
